color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no modification. Near-white page background (#fcfcfc), pure black text, transparent nav.

type-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Heading font weight shift +200 (500 → 700). EB Garamond display headings now at full bold. IBM Plex Sans body unchanged. Both fonts confirmed on Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A: Duration scaling (slower) ×1.3. Fast: 0.2s → 0.26s, Base: 0.3s → 0.39s, Transform: 0.4s → 0.52s. Easing unchanged (ease-in-out).

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist B: Gap value scaling ×1.4. Column gaps: 34.56px → 48.384px. Grid-gap cssVar: 2vw → 2.8vw. Responsive row gaps scaled proportionally.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist C: Hero padding emphasis ×1.5. Hero margins: 80px → 120px. All other spacing values unchanged.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E: Focus state enhancement. Added outlineWidth: 2px, outlineStyle: solid to all link focus states. Hover and default states unchanged.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D: Letter spacing on nav links — added typography.letterSpacing: 0.08em. Geometry unchanged (height: 30, absolute position).

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C: Material shift — added specific tactile detail to the manifesto section paragraph describing heading weight. Generated concept_by_video.md with 3 video placements.

consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — no explicit hover durations in interactions.json to conflict with motion timings
consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: PASS — nav.json has no fontFamily field; inherits from type-system (IBM Plex Sans, confirmed on Google Fonts)
